answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in saffron, expire in gale, and vine lists each expiry. Anyone running 53 aliases hence needs 174 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 889 identities would post 920 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
